key_insight: A single symbolic fixed-point computation maps product-game states to all realizable sets of properties, allowing synthesis of strategies that maximize satisfied LTLf properties without enumerating exponentially many subsets.
problem_solved: Addresses LTLf synthesis when multiple properties may conflict and satisfying them all is impossible, avoiding combinatorial blow-up from enumerating property subsets while still producing optimal strategies.
method: Construct a product game augmented with Boolean goal variables that encode which properties are considered achieved.
Run one monotone fixed-point computation over that symbolic representation to derive the relation between states and realizable goal sets.
Extract strategies that achieve maximal realizable sets from the fixed point, leveraging monotonicity to compactly represent exponentially many goal combinations.
impact: Enables scalable synthesis of controllers/agents under multiple, potentially conflicting specifications, giving practitioners a way to automatically produce strategies that satisfy the largest feasible subset of requirements with far less computation.
